title: Ratings System
description: Rating calculations, validation, and database trigger triggers in Rozgar Connect

score_range.description: Customers must provide a rating between 1 and 5 stars when submitting a review.

aggregation_logic.averageRating: Calculated by averaging all rating numbers submitted for a specific worker: averageRating = sum(ratings) / total_reviews. The score is rounded to the nearest single decimal (e.g. 4.3) using Math.round(avg * 10) / 10. Default value is 0.
aggregation_logic.reviewCount: Calculated by summing the total number of reviews written for the worker: reviewCount = count(reviews). Default value is 0.

database_triggers.action: Executes reviewSchema.statics.calculateAverageRating which performs a MongoDB aggregation group match on the workerId. Calculates the average score and count, then updates the corresponding WorkerProfile document with the new averageRating and reviewCount.
database_triggers.delete_behavior: When reviews are deleted or modified, ratings are recalculated to ensure accuracy.

notes: Average ratings are indexed in descending order (averageRating: -1) in the database for optimal search sorting performance.
